title: CCDWIKI: Decoupling Case Formulation from Response Generation in Longitudinal CBT Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2611.05383v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) demands more than empathic validation, requiring instead a structured formulation of the interplay among situations, automatic thoughts, emotions, and behaviors. Therapists formalize this interplay through a Cognitive Conceptualization Diagram, where maintaining longitudinal coherence necessitates continuous evidential adjudication to separate tentative hypotheses from established findings. Current dialogue systems track conversational history via retrieval or static profiles but lack the representational capacity to encode epistemic status. Consequently, provisional interpretations are often prematurely reified as established facts, inadvertently biasing downstream interventions. Addressing this limitation, CCDWiki is introduced as a plug-and-play advisor conceptualizing longitudinal therapy as evidence-grounded hypothesis adjudication. translated_title: CCDWIKI：在纵向认知行为疗法（CBT）对话中将个案概念化与回复生成解耦
translated_abstract: 认知行为疗法（CBT）所要求的不仅仅是共情式的情感确认，而是需要对情境、自动化思维、情绪和行为之间的相互作用进行结构化的个案概念化。治疗师通过认知概念化图将这种相互作用形式化，其中维持纵向连贯性需要持续的证据裁定，以区分暂定的假设与已确立的发现。当前的对话系统通过检索或静态用户画像来追踪对话历史，但缺乏编码认知状态的表征能力。因此，暂时性的解释往往被过早地固化为已确立的事实，从而在无意中对下游干预造成偏差。针对这一局限，本文提出了CCDWiki，作为一个即插即用的顾问模块，将纵向治疗概念化为基于证据的假设裁定过程。该方法将每个临床假设编码为一个可动态更新的条目，以追踪其证据状态（注：原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出CCDWiki这一即插即用顾问模块，将纵向CBT对话中的个案概念化建模为基于证据的假设裁定过程，通过对临床假设进行动态编码来区分暂定假设与已确立事实，避免暂时性解释被过早固化为事实而误导干预。
en_tdlr: CCDWiki is introduced as a plug-and-play advisor that reformulates longitudinal CBT dialogue case formulation as evidence-grounded hypothesis adjudication, encoding each clinical hypothesis as a mutable entry to prevent tentative interpretations from being prematurely reified as established facts.
